requirements: Every installed surface has its own rollback entry. Rollback is per surface and is never falsely atomic.
Capture the prior known-good payload identity for a surface BEFORE the first install mutation on that surface. A capture taken after the write is not a known-good identity.
Where a surface genuinely held no prior payload, record priorIdentity as absent:<REASON> and make removal the rollback action. Never leave it null.
Capture the candidate payload identity as part of the install receipt for that surface.
A location is not an identity. A path can be rewritten, and a path to an uncommitted local file cannot be restored from.
Rollback removes the candidate payload, any adapter or hook it installed, and any cached evidence home it created.
Rollback restores the prior known-good payload and reruns that surface's prior entry proof.
If the candidate changed wake or compaction behavior, verify the prior post-compaction behavior is restored.
Publication never implies install state, and install state never implies behavioral proof.
A surface with no durable prior and candidate identity is not installable.

surfaces.rollbackAction: Remove the candidate payload and adapter, restore the prior known-good payload, and rerun this surface's entry proof.
